agent.description: A molecular entity, e.g., a protein.

name.description: The name of the agent, preferably a canonicalized name such as an HGNC gene name.

mutations.description: Amino acid mutations of the agent.

bound_conditions.description: Other agents bound to the agent in this context.

location.description: Cellular location of the agent. Must be a valid name (e.g. 'nucleus') or identifier (e.g. 'GO:0005634')for a GO cellular compartment.

db_refs.description: Dictionary of database identifiers associated with this agent.

sbo.description: Role of this agent in the systems biology ontology

from_location.description: The location from which the agent translocates. This must be a valid GO cellular component name (e.g. 'cytoplasm') or ID (e.g. 'GO:0005737').

to_location.description: The location to which the agent translocates. This must be a valid GO cellular component name or ID.

Translocation.description: All statement types, below, may have these fields and 'inherit' from this schema

RegulateAmount.description: All statement types, below, may have these fields and 'inherit' from this schema

obj_from.description: The list of molecular species being consumed by the conversion.

obj_to.description: The list of molecular species being created by the conversion.

Conversion.description: All statement types, below, may have these fields and 'inherit' from this schema

Statement.description: All statement types, below, may have these fields and 'inherit' from this schema

Evidence.description: Container for evidence supporting a given statement.

text.description: Natural language text supporting the statement.

source_api.description: String identifying the INDRA API used to capture the statement, e.g., 'trips', 'biopax', 'bel'.

pmid.description: String indicating the Pubmed ID of the source of the statement.

source_id.description: For statements drawn from databases, ID of the database entity corresponding to the statement.

annotations.description: Dictionary containing additional information on the context of the statement, e.g., species, cell line, tissue type, etc. The entries may vary depending on the source of the information.

epistemics.description: A dictionary describing various forms of epistemic certainty associated with the statement.

Agent.description: A molecular entity, e.g., a protein.

name.description: The name of the agent, preferably a canonicalized name such as an HGNC gene name.

mutations.description: Amino acid mutations of the agent.

bound_conditions.description: Other agents bound to the agent in this context.

location.description: Cellular location of the agent. Must be a valid name (e.g. 'nucleus') or identifier (e.g. 'GO:0005634')for a GO cellular compartment.

db_refs.description: Dictionary of database identifiers associated with this agent.

sbo.description: Role of this agent in the systems biology ontology

ModCondition.description: Mutation state of an amino acid position of an Agent.

mod_type.description: The type of post-translational modification, e.g., 'phosphorylation'. Valid modification types currently include: 'phosphorylation', 'ubiquitination', 'sumoylation', 'hydroxylation', and 'acetylation'. If an invalid modification type is passed an InvalidModTypeError is raised.

residue.description: String indicating the modified amino acid, e.g., 'Y' or 'tyrosine'. If None, indicates that the residue at the modification site is unknown or unspecified.

position.description: String indicating the position of the modified amino acid, e.g., '202'. If None, indicates that the position is unknown or unspecified.

is_modified.description: Specifies whether the modification is present or absent. Setting the flag specifies that the Agent with the ModCondition is unmodified at the site.

MutCondition.description: Mutation state of an amino acid position of an Agent.

position.description: Residue position of the mutation in the protein sequence.

residue_from.description: Wild-type (unmodified) amino acid residue at the given position.

residue_to.description: Amino acid at the position resulting from the mutation.

ActivityCondition.description: An active or inactive state of a protein.

activity_type.description: The type of activity, e.g. 'kinase'. The basic, unspecified molecular activity is represented as 'activity'. Examples of other activity types are 'kinase', 'phosphatase', 'catalytic', 'transcription', etc.

is_active.description: Specifies whether the given activity type is present or absent.

BoundCondition.description: Identify Agents bound (or not bound) to a given Agent in a given context.

is_bound.description: Specifies whether the given Agent is bound or unbound in the current context.
